Zillow ZHVI is a MIX-CONTROLLED index built to track a consistent housing stock. A rising median beside a falling index is the SIGNATURE of an upward composition shift, and this is the SEVENTH-PLUS instance of the composition-mask class on this domain (KB-HOMER-013). ★★ THE PERIMETER HYPOTHESIS IS REFUTED, NOT MERELY DEPRIORITIZED — AND IT WAS WALTER'S OWN 'CHECK THIS FIRST' CANDIDATE. He reasoned that FL Realtors is STATEWIDE while the table is SIX COUNTIES, so strong non-top-50 counties could flip the sign. That fails on its own evidence: MIAMI-DADE IS SIMULTANEOUSLY A NEGATIVE-ZHVI COUNTY (-1.6% YoY) AND THE COUNTY POSTING +29.14% YoY GROWTH IN $1M+ SALES IN THE SAME MONTH (MIAMI REALTORS, June-2026). The SAME geography produces both signs, so the disagreement CANNOT be statewide-vs-counties; it is mix-sensitive-vs-mix-controlled WITHIN one perimeter. ★ TWO INDEPENDENT DISTORTIONS INFLATE THE +4.9%, AND BOTH ARE DOCUMENTED BY THE PUBLISHER: (1) UPWARD MIX SHIFT — the $1M+ tier is growing far faster than the overall count (Miami-Dade $1M+ sales +29.14% YoY June; Sarasota-Bradenton single-family >$1M 220 closings +38.4% YoY and the $2M-$3M band 51 sales +218.8% YoY; statewide Q2 townhouse/condo $1M+ sales +29.5% to 2,195), against total single-family closed sales of just +9.3% — a transaction set skewing rich lifts the median MECHANICALLY with no house rising in value. (2) WEAK BASE — Florida Realtors' OWN economist says so: 'June 2025 was a particularly weak sales month, which helped make this year's percentage gains appear larger,' and director of economic development Jennifer Warner places current sales 'more closely tracking 2023 levels.' ⚠️ WHAT THIS DOES AND DOES NOT SAY: it does NOT say CORAL's number is wrong — it is correctly sourced and correctly computed. IT SAYS THE NUMBER CANNOT CARRY THE INFERENCE 'FL SINGLE-FAMILY PRICES ARE RISING 4.9%.' The mix-controlled read of the same state in the same month is NEGATIVE across every major county. ⚠️ RESIDUAL UNCERTAINTY, NOT CLOSED: the ZHVI leg rests on a screenshot WALTER did not source-verify, so the six county figures are UNCONFIRMED AT PRIMARY; ZHVI smoothing/revision behaviour, contract-vs-close timing, and single-family-only vs all-housing-types coverage remain un-excluded as CONTRIBUTING factors. The composition mechanism is the leading and now well-corroborated explanation — it is NOT a completed proof. ⚠️ ZERO THRESHOLD MOVED; no band on this file or any other was touched.
